PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?id WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?r a sphn:FollowUp .
    ?r sphn:hasResult ?n1 .
    ?n1 sphn:hasDeath ?n2 .
    ?n2 sphn:hasReportDateTime ?v .
    FILTER (?v >= "1991-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)
    ?r sphn:hasSubjectPseudoIdentifier ?s .
    ?s sphn:hasIdentifier ?id .
  }
}
